72.long: Walk up one step; in the clock tower, hop (hold to hop higher).

80.long: Walk down one step; hold to keep walking.

75.long: Walk left one step; hold to keep walking.

77.long: Walk right one step; hold to keep walking.

16.long: In the clock tower, hop up and to the left.

18.long: In the clock tower, hop up and to the right.

71.long: Number pad 7: in the clock tower, hop up and to the left.

73.long: Number pad 9: in the clock tower, hop up and to the right.

57.long: Pick up what you are standing on. With the winding key, one big spring hop each press.

28.long: With the heart balloon, rise as long as you hold it and it has air. A puff of breeze fills it again.

45.long: With the Bard's drumstick, throw a friendly BOOM the way Joe last moved. It cheers up anything grumpy.
